description: Store a file given as base64 for 24 hours, at a link that anyone who has it can open. Answers storage_id and storage_url. Use it to hand a file to another tool, such as an image to process_image or read_qr_code. Never store secrets or personal data. No API key, no account and no sign up: call it directly.

data_base64.description: The file as standard base64, at most about 190 KB of file through MCP. For a larger file, store it with REST POST /services/v1/storage first and pass storage_id.

name: store_file
title: Store a file
